bullets.text: Q3 CR was 90.3 and YTD CR remained sub 90; Q3 Property CR was 102.3 (103.3 YTD), and September Property CR included about 6 points reflecting Hurricane Florence claims.
NPW grew 20% for Q3 and 21% YTD, surpassing $30 billion on a trailing 12-month basis after reaching $20 billion in 2015, gaining $10 billion in a few short years.
Companywide PIF surpassed 20 million, including over 13 million Auto PIFs, 2 million 10-year-plus customers, and 1 million Robinsons; direct bundled home/auto PIFs grew nearly 30% YOY.
Portfolio returned 1.2% (equities +7.4%); sold $300 million in equities on higher valuations; issued $550 million in 10-year 4.00% notes, keeping total debt-to-capital below the 30% ceiling.
Personal auto frequency continues to decline, offset somewhat by rising severity; industry average premiums are still rising YOY, but not at the rate witnessed during the past 18 months.
Put new Nashville catastrophe center to use for Florence, with insignificant vehicle impact; deployed over 300 personnel and photo estimating for Hurricane Michael to settle claims more expediently.

Soft-launched BusinessQuote Explorer for small business with three carrier partners; latest auto model reached 15 states (~40% of written premium); piloted Snapshot mobile algorithm tracking distracted driving.

All Personal Lines converted new business to PolicyPro; launched "Cover with Confidence" machine-learning quoting; Snapshot collected 1.5B+ mobile miles; tested chat on HomeQuote Explorer point-of-sale platform.

Launched Portfolio Quoting agency pilot in Missouri; Agency bundled home/auto PIFs rose over 40% YTD; direct Property added 53 state/carrier/product combinations; online buy was offered on about half of online quotes.

Rotated senior leadership roles via job swaps across functional areas; found qualified talent without trouble even with a tight labor market; an evacuated claims employee worked customer claims while her property was flooded.
